scope: Separate offline full-field precision/sensitivity validation of the same frozen primary formula. Original native FD64 result remains INCONCLUSIVE; no native retry or solver/physics/tolerance/step-size change.
source_equations: calc_p_rho_wrf + horizontal_pgf_primary + actual canonical coupled/physical mass conversion; original source operation order; positive dry/unit-map branch only
projection: use actual captured projected EOS base and native Qz; output core V faces j1..79,x0..39,k0..63, unchanged by supported output Q

precision.operands: exact binary values from stored float32/float64; source cpovcv first rounded as original double(cp)/double(cv), then promoted

required_fullfield: all physical interior V points, each original width reported; at least2/3 complete widths pass, no subsets selected

fixed_precision_samples.additional: union argmax abs(FWAD) and minimum nonzero abs(FWAD), deterministic first flat index

precision_stability_rule: 160-vs256 FD derivative abs difference <=1e-20 +1e-12*abs(FD256) on all declared samples/widths
branch_gate: recompute perturbed mu-dependent face masses/numerators/denominators; no active floor/nonpositive mass/alpha/theta, actual cq/maps consistent or remainINCONCLUSIVE
interpretation: higher precision suppresses intermediate FP64 rounding; supports only independent derivative/roundoff analysis on frozen data, cannot relabel original native FD flags or automatically authorize correction/performance
